gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 identifies the exact failure in a10: a18 requires Lagrange-norm control on supp(nu), while a50 supplies control only on supp(mu), with no hypothesis relating the supports. It also identifies the resulting invalid direct combination and gives the corresponding mixed-support repair.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both entries diagnose the unsupported use of a50 to supply the supp(nu) estimate required by a18 when nu and mu may have unrelated supports, so the asserted rate and direct proof of a10 do not follow.

component_coverage.gold_component: The a18/a50 combination uses a bound on supp(mu) where a bound on supp(nu) is required, without any support relation, invalidating the asserted a10 rate.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly contrasts the supp(nu) norm in a18 with the supp(mu) estimate in a50, notes the absence of a relating hypothesis and the resulting falsity of a10 for arbitrary nu, and proposes either matching supports or the correct mixed-support reformulation.
